patterns.name: suspicious_autostart_registration
patterns.condition: High severity, source, persistence action, explicit suspicious indicator, and temporary executable/startup folder or correlated unsigned service registrations.

patterns.name: suspicious_scheduled_task
patterns.condition: High-severity suspicious newly configured task with source and temporary executable.

patterns.name: persistence_context_needs_review
patterns.condition: Medium-severity persistence observation without enough corroboration to block.

guardrails: Do not block merely for the MITRE label, an executable path, or a high Wazuh rule level.
Treat routine updates, signed services, read-only observations and incomplete telemetry conservatively.
Use event-specific data.count only; rule.firedtimes is not evidence of repeated changes.
A block decision does not terminate a real service, process, or scheduled task.
The fixture is synthetic course data, not a production endpoint policy.
